name: @xhis/postgres-shell
description: A real, multi-writer-safe ImperativeShell backed by a shared Postgres cluster -- row-level tenancy via tenant_id + RLS, optimistic concurrency via a UNIQUE(tenant_id, version) constraint. Built only on @xhis/core's public export surface, same as @xhis/xguard; @xhis/core itself stays dependency-free.
